## New: Automations workflow builder

Build a workflow once and it runs on its own for every business it finds.

- **Canvas builder**: drag Email, Wait, Condition and Action steps onto the canvas and connect them. Conditions have yes/no branches. Click a step to configure it.
- **Triggers**: a search finishes (enter a niche and location, then Save & Run), a business gets a label, or a mockup is ready.
- **Email**: messages with fill-ins like `{{business}}`, `{{city}}` and `{{top_issue}}`, optionally with a preview image of the mockup. Sent from your own mailbox over SMTP, 45 seconds apart, within a daily limit. There's a Preview and a "send a test to yourself" button.
- **Stops on reply**: the app reads your inbox every few minutes. When a business writes back, every workflow stops for it and it gets the label "replied". Out-of-office replies and bounces don't count.
- **Actions**: create a mockup card, add or remove a label, notify you, stop.
- **Activity tab**: every business, which step it's on, and a log of what happened.
- The ready-made workflow finds businesses, makes a mockup for each, emails the ones with an address and follows up after 3 days. The rest get the label "call".

**Set up first:** Settings → Integrations → Outreach email (address, SMTP server, password, daily limit) and the Replies inbox (IMAP server). Use "Test the mailbox" and "Test the replies inbox".

## Also in this version

- **Launch & SEO → Go-live tab**:
  - WordPress go-live kit: UpdraftPlus, Wordfence, FluentSMTP, security hardening, agency admin email, WebP, llms.txt.
  - Go-live checks, DNS snapshot, cutover and verify for any DNS provider.
  - Direct SMTP and IMAP mail checks, email delivery test with SPF/DKIM results.
  - Redirect map from the old site, and the project record.
- Schema is no longer printed twice when Yoast or Rank Math is active.
- Client sites need the updated Studio Connector plugin: download it again from the site's page.

To install: download the .exe below and run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the installer isn't code-signed yet: choose More info → Run anyway.
